base: Two separate bases: value of all property received and under the personal representative's possession and control, and all disbursements (Ala. Code § 43-2-848(a)).

schedules.who: Personal representative on property received (Ala. Code § 43-2-848(a)) (maximum)
schedules.text: Reasonable compensation not exceeding 2.5% of the value of all property received and under the personal representative's control (Ala. Code § 43-2-848(a)).
schedules.capNote: Cap on reasonable compensation; extraordinary services extra (§ 43-2-848(b)).

schedules.text: Plus not exceeding 2.5% of all disbursements (Ala. Code § 43-2-848(a)).
schedules.capNote: Applied to disbursements, a separate base.

testCases.source: computed by hand: 2.5% of 200,000 received and 2.5% of 200,000 disbursed
